_notice: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE DATA - NOT REAL ANNOUNCEMENTS. These records exist only to document the local import schema and to exercise the pipeline offline. Every title is invented, the source_ids are fake, and the document_url values are non-resolving placeholders. Do not draw any market conclusion from them, and do not import this file into the same environment you use for real research: run it with ENVIRONMENT=dev so it lands in var/dev/ and stays isolated from var/paper/.

_schema.published_at: ISO-8601; read as IST when it carries no offset
_schema.event_type: one of: results, results_date, dividend, split_bonus, pledge, insider_or_promoter, order_win, litigation_or_regulatory, management_change, rating_change, fundraise, other
_schema.direction: optional; only supply it if your licensed source states it. positive | negative | neutral | unclear
_schema.materiality: optional; only supply it if your licensed source states it. minor | moderate | major
_schema.note: Records imported today keep today's receipt and recording timestamps. Nothing here is backdated.
